entries.title: Genesis 28:1
segments: ¶And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said to him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

entries.title: Genesis 28:2
segments: Arise, go to Padan-Aram, to the house of Bethuel thy mother's father, and take a wife thence of the daughters of Laban thy mother's brother.

entries.title: Genesis 28:3
segments: And the Almighty *God bless thee, and make thee fruitful and multiply thee, that thou mayest become a company of peoples.

entries.title: Genesis 28:4
segments: And may he give thee the blessing of Abraham, to thee and to thy seed with thee, in order that thou mayest possess the land of thy sojourning, which God gave to Abraham!

entries.title: Genesis 28:5
segments: And Isaac sent away Jacob; and he went to Padan-Aram, to Laban the son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebecca, Jacob's and Esau's mother.

entries.title: Genesis 28:6
segments: ¶And Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and sent him away to Padan-Aram, to take a wife thence, blessing him, and giving him a charge saying, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;

entries.title: Genesis 28:7
segments: and [that] Jacob had obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Padan-Aram.

entries.title: Genesis 28:8
segments: And Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan were evil in the sight of Isaac his father.

entries.title: Genesis 28:9
segments: And Esau went to Ishmael, and took, besides the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham's son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.

entries.title: Genesis 28:10
segments: ¶And Jacob went out from Beer-sheba, and went towards Haran.

entries.title: Genesis 28:11
segments: And he lighted on a certain place, and lodged there, because the sun had set. And he took [one] of the stones of the place, and made [it] his pillow, and lay down in that place.

entries.title: Genesis 28:12
segments: And he dreamed, and behold, a ladder was set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to the heavens. And behold, angels of God ascended and descended upon it.

entries.title: Genesis 28:13
segments: And behold, Jehovah stood above it. And he said, I am Jehovah, the God of Abraham, thy father, and the God of Isaac: the land on which thou liest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed.

entries.title: Genesis 28:14
segments: And thy seed shall be as the dust of the earth, and thou shalt spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south; and in thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

entries.title: Genesis 28:15
segments: And behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all [places] to which thou goest, and will bring thee again into this land; for I will not leave thee until I have done what I have spoken to thee of.

entries.title: Genesis 28:16
segments: ¶And Jacob awoke from his sleep, and said, Surely Jehovah is in this place, and I knew [it] not.

entries.title: Genesis 28:17
segments: And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.

entries.title: Genesis 28:18
segments: And Jacob rose early in the morning, and took the stone that he had made his pillow, and set it up [for] a pillar, and poured oil on the top of it.

entries.title: Genesis 28:19
segments: And he called the name of that place Beth-el; but the name of that city was Luz at the first.

entries.title: Genesis 28:20
segments: And Jacob vowed a vow, saying, If God will be with me, and keep me on this road that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and a garment to put on,

entries.title: Genesis 28:21
segments: and I come again to my father's house in peace--then shall Jehovah be my God.

entries.title: Genesis 28:22
segments: And this stone, which I have set up [for] a pillar, shall be God's house; and of all that thou wilt give me I will without fail give the tenth to thee.
